description: Stay in a magnificent 350 m² private mansion combining elegance, comfort and high-end services. This exceptional residence, which can accommodate up to 10 guests, features spacious living areas, a private bar with a refined style, elegant bedrooms and a pleasant outdoor area ideal for relaxing or sharing convivial moments. A unique place to enjoy an unforgettable experience with family, friends or during a business trip. – hotel-type listing
